baseline.meaning: Previously inspected original shared-v1 fails at81 intervals on nonfinite initial objective/gradient. Structured causal-history result hits. Reuse context only; no baseline optimizer rerun.

controller.bridge: Exact source-bound shared_vehicle_dart.physical_rollout(SimpleNamespace(_model=loaded_core),intrinsic=True) and live_initial(shared_vehicle,...). Position via trapezoidal velocity; intrinsic rotations to WXYZ quaternion. No bridge/mechanics/filter changes.
controller.optimizer: unchanged scipy L-BFGS-B, ftol1e-12,gtol1e-5,maxls40,maxcor30, inherited SciPy maxfun default; no extra gradient-call cap or stopping modification
controller.precision: Ambient JAX x64 disabled; actual JAX callback inputs/outputs recorded at their real dtype. SciPy x and returned gradient conversion retain original behavior.
controller.stop: Unchanged: first point/plane crossing,120 executed intervals, or existing exception. Nonconvergence and intermediate nonfinite proposals do not introduce new stops.
controller.time_limit_policy: Hard supervisor limit for the one control worker. Preserve all started/returned events and completed artifacts on timeout; mark incomplete, not success. No automatic restart.
controller.warm_start: Exact original120x4 float64 tape first; each returned plan shifts three entries and repeats its final command3times. Every solve uses full120-step learned rollout even as active_steps=120-origin declines.

dart.prelude_policy: Import exact saved actual51 native17 states/50 issued4 commands. Start plant from its final saved native17 state and predictor from observed13 plus canonical15/issued histories; no fabricated history or old selected solve. No new prelude execution during trial. Native replay explicitly verifies50 prelude steps against frozen initial plant state.

measurements.numerical: Every solve/callback/selected/native started/returned/raised count, first bad identity and solve origin. Every objective/gradient element finite separately; norm/max with float64 arithmetic. Selected full mean and native returned state finiteness. Preserve convergence/status/iterations/initial and final objectives/timing per solve; nonfinite scalars encoded explicit strings in JSON with full arrays authoritative.

readouts.numerical_compatibility: true iff evidence qualified, trial returns normally at first contact or120 intervals, all durable calls close, every actual objective and gradient finite, every selected mean/native returned state finite, and no call/solver exception. Optimizer nonconvergence is reported independently and does not alone fail numerical compatibility.
readouts.past_original_failure_origin: Executed more than81 intervals; descriptive only, does not imply contact or numerical adequacy.
readouts.promotion: false regardless of either outcome; this known nominal trial does not qualify all configurations or resolve accuracy/calibration obligations.
readouts.task_success: Evidence qualified AND trial normal completion AND unchanged canonical contact hit; independent contact Booleans must agree. May differ from numerical compatibility; retain both.

measurements.task: Unchanged first front-to-back contact via mission.score_contact. Report physical miss, top-axis error (yawfree), incoming normal/tangent speed, contact/deadline/exception and executed intervals; no new tolerances.

named_gap: Dart planner compatibility of the fixed supported shared-physics revision

alterations: candidate numeric model array rejected by embedded fingerprint and external anchor
actual gradient proposal changed with local hash repaired rejected by original external stage authority and causal/block reconstruction
executed command/native state changed with repaired local seal rejected by external authority and independent causal continuity
numerical or task readout changed rejected by independent reduction

contact_comparison.boundary_policy: Any Boolean/interval disagreement or scalar excess fails independent comparison; never tolerance-adjust a task success. These prospective numerical audit budgets are not universal error bounds.

proof.failure: Scientific trial failure is valid diagnostic evidence if fully recorded/replayed/audited. Supervisor timeout or incomplete call cannot become successful qualification. No retuning or extra trials after results; harness-only corrections need new source binding and preserve completed scientific work.
proof.freeze: Commit protocol before implementation. Commit complete implementation/tests; archive source and bind clean source/runtime, pinned core/bridge/Dart/simulator bytes, all artifacts before any model/gradient/simulator/optimizer call.
proof.independent: NumPy-only derive causal observation histories/command expansion/seed shifting/executed-prefix selection, durable counts/finiteness/readout from saved arrays; independent quaternion/SLERP/contact-offset firstcrossing score. Scalar tolerances below permit floating-point implementation differences only; task thresholds never change.
proof.replay: Exact dtype/shape/numeric equality including NaNs for saved actual callbacks, full selected means, native states, input/seed reconstruction, canonical contact and raw readout. No optimizer in replay. Actual exceptions preserved and compared. Imported prelude exact botharrayandhistoricalstageanchors.

recording.durability: Exclusive outputs. Atomically save and fsync actual inputs before every solve, actual value/gradient callback, final selected-mean invocation and native plant step; durably mark started before invoking. Save full returned arrays and returned/raised records before downstream validation. Keep exceptions/partial traces and never restart a scientific prefix.
recording.gradients: Wrap planner.value_gradient without transforming arguments/returns or adding calls. Capture flat160 float32 actual JAX proposals, active_steps and causal input identity; expanded commands, objective scalar and full gradient array; objective-finite and gradient-finite separately. Include initial evaluation, duplicates and every line-search proposal.
recording.plant: Wrapper records actual native17-state/issued4 command and returned17 state before existing finite check. Saved executed trajectory contains only accepted actual states, with failed returned state still retained separately.
recording.privacy: Predictor receives observed13/canonical15 motion history and issued commands only. Native actuator-state tail is used by simulator truth and evidence, never by model or planner history.
recording.selected_means: After DirectPlanner construction, wrap planner.rollout only. Its objective retains the original closed-over rollout. Record each actual selected mean before DirectPlanner rejects nonfinite output, preserving full121x13 including initial state and inactive future. Return original object unchanged.

scope: One newly executed supported-revision trial on the already inspected nominal Dart task. Historical comparator trials are context, not new measurements. No fitting, support derivation, weight/map/controller change, public promotion, physical derivative accuracy, calibration or arbitrary-system claim.

work.replay: Exactly once reexecute each recorded native plant call, selected120-step mean, and actual value/gradient callback from saved inputs; separately verify historical50-step prelude. No optimizer, seed search, new control rollout or refit. Preserve nonfinite arrays and exceptions. Report trial vs replay call counts distinctly. Independent audit and alterations use saved arrays only.
